name: Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, IRCTC is a Navratna (Category 1, Central Public Sector Enterprises ) and the only company authorized by the Indian government to provide online railway tickets, catering services, and packaged drinking water at railway stations and trains in India [1]

flags.text: Operating margin compressed from 36% to 32% over three years.
Working-capital cycle stretched from 3 to 40 days.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Revenue grew 18.10% YoY in Q1 FY27
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q1 revenue ₹1,370 cr vs ₹1,160 cr prior year – 18.10% growth matches claim

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Operating margin compressed from 36% to 32% over three years
narrative_vs_numbers.revenue: Operating margin FY23 36%, FY24 34.4%, FY25 33.2%, FY26 31.9% – trend confirms compression

narrative_vs_numbers.reality: EBITDA ₹386 cr vs prior year not disclosed; decline claim unverified

bull.point: Free cash flow reached ₹1,182 cr FY26; 5‑yr cash conversion 79%
Zero debt and strong cash from operations (₹1,273 cr FY26)

bear.point: Working‑capital days rose to 40, indicating slower cash cycle
EBITDA fell 2.77% YoY in Q1 FY27

synthesis.one_line: IRCTC delivers strong top‑line growth and cash generation but margin compression and longer cash cycles raise caution.
